sources.entry: Hammerspoon - Staggeringly powerful macOS desktop automation with Lua.

summary.one_liner: Hammerspoon is a macOS automation tool that bridges the operating system to a Lua scripting engine, using extensions to control many aspects of the desktop.
summary.what_it_does: Hammerspoon acts as a bridge between OS X and a Lua scripting engine. A set of extensions exposes specific pieces of system functionality, which users call from Lua scripts to control many parts of their macOS environment. Out of the box it does nothing; the user creates ~/.hammerspoon/init.lua with their own code. The README points to a Getting Started Guide, API docs, FAQ, sample configurations from users, a contribution guide, an IRC channel on Libera, and a Google Group for support. It is a fork of Mjolnir, and the stated future direction is wider system API coverage, tighter integration between extensions, and a smoother user experience.
use_cases: automate macOS desktop tasks with Lua scripts
bind keyboard shortcuts to system actions
extend macOS with custom automation code
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the project's releases and drag Hammerspoon.app from Downloads to Applications
Or install with Homebrew: brew install hammerspoon --cask
Create ~/.hammerspoon/init.lua and add Lua code to it
notable: Lua scripting bridge to macOS system functionality via extensions
Fork of Mjolnir with a more integrated experience
Installable manually or via Homebrew cask
Community resources including sample configurations and an IRC channel
caveats: macOS only (README refers to OS X)
Does nothing out of the box; requires writing Lua configuration
